author: Codex documentation author

scenarios.expected: New and existing records reflect the documented configuration and retained-value behavior. Immutable Stage/Category mappings and invalid reassignment are refused; non-Administrators cannot edit configuration.
scenarios.actual: Followed the guide as Daniel Okafor on the owned configuration lab. Created and renamed a Matter type, keyboard-reordered it, and confirmed the immutable Slug in Edit. Created a Global single-select Field, confirmed its immutable type, attached it to a Matter type and set Required; creation with the answer empty was refused by name ("Fill Ind coverage region IND81T2F.") and succeeded once supplied. Detach kept the catalog definition and the stored value; catalog Archive hid the row while keeping attachments and the stored answer, and Show archived plus Restore recovered it. In Edit, narrowing the Global Field to a module was refused while a Contract type still attached it ("...is attached outside the matter module — detach it there first...") and succeeded after detaching, with stored values retained. Contract Statuses: created on a chosen Stage, renaming kept the Stage, the Draft/Active/Expired seeds show a protected lock instead of an archive control, and an in-use Status was blocked (409) with no reassignment control until the Contract was moved by hand. Matter Statuses: an in-use custom Status offered only same-Category replacements and moved the Matter on confirmation. Archiving an in-use Matter type moved its records to the chosen replacement and Restore did not move them back; Other is protected. Archiving an in-use Officer role moved both a current and a resigned appointment to the replacement, and Restore did not reverse it. Nadia Haddad (Legal) and Ravi Menon (Contributor) saw no Organization rail entries, were redirected to /settings/profile from every configuration pane, and were refused 403 on a direct write.

technicalReview.scope: Read the settings rail and its Organization-only guard (apps/web/src/routes/settings.tsx), the four Types panes and the shared archive/reassignment guard (settings-contract-types.tsx, settings-matter-types.tsx, settings-entity-types.tsx, settings-knowledge-types.tsx, components/taxonomy-types-pane.tsx), the Status panes and their fixed backbones (settings-contract-statuses.tsx STAGES and PROTECTED_SLUGS, settings-matter-statuses.tsx categories and same-category reassignment), the Field catalog and its nine types, scope moves and AI-prompt rule (settings-contract-fields.tsx, apps/api/src/modules/fields/routes.ts), the type editors' attachment surface and immutable Slug (settings-contract-type-editor.tsx, settings-matter-type-editor.tsx, components/type-editor-screen.tsx), the hard-required rule and its two deliberate skips (apps/api/src/lib/custom-fields.ts), and Officer-role usage counting resigned appointments (apps/api/src/modules/officer-roles/usage.ts).
technicalReview.notHeld: An agent source review of the release under test. It is not a human feature owner's sign-off on behaviour accuracy, and it is not the user's final proofreading of the assembled suite.
